properties.site-address: T Northeast Ltd. 4 Station Road, Horley
properties.notes: The site lies within the Station Road Horley Local Centre. Development Management Plan policies RET1 and RET3 require the retention of an active retail frontage and resists the loss of A1-A4 and D1/2 unless it can be demonstrated that reasonable attempts have been made for a minimum of 6 months to let/sell for retail and/or community uses and that the proposal would make a positive contribution to vitality and viability to the local centre.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
